rows.arity_note: one active-value or ordinary stored-value input; contextual object/variable/prop/type metadata follows section 5.5
rows.observable_law: Nested getter evaluation first resolves deeper localState (inner→outer) and returns the outermost getFn result; a missing getFn yields the resolved localState.
positive_witnesses: Nested stored 10; inner get adds 2, outer get multiplies by 3 -> 36, trace inner:get,outer:get.
A plain value is read unchanged, and getFn absent returns child-localState result.
falsifiers: Executing outer get before inner get returns a different result/trace.
GetLocalStateOnly must not invoke any nested getFn, and must expose immediate nested value.
rows.unresolved_independence: Could be derived using closures wrapping DEREF with explicitly composed observers.

rows.arity_note: active-value, new-value, contextual object/variable/prop/type metadata; an accessor may delegate to its nested local state
rows.observable_law: An outer putFn is invoked first and may call PutLocalState, triggering inner putFns outer→inner; if putFn absent, store new value as this node's localState, without mandatory propagation; raw only bypass skips inner effects.
positive_witnesses: Nested state 10; put 19 with outer and inner delegating writes -> trace outer:put,inner:put and terminal state 19.
An outer handler that does not delegate leaves inner state unchanged; absent putFn replaces its own localState.
falsifiers: Invoking inner put before outer violates nested ordering.
A putFn that deliberately does not delegate must not trigger inner put; PutLocalStateOnly must suppress nested handlers.
rows.unresolved_independence: Potential closure-based composition; must prove material language-visible difference before ratification.

holds.reason: Observed bypass access may be a projection of raw localState storage; positive/negative witnesses remain in checker and must not be counted twice.
Replacing one nested active value is not yet shown distinct from locating a stored cell plus normal update.
holds.source_section: The LOOPS Manual 5.5, printed page 28 (PDF page 32)
holds.positive_witness: Replace the innermost active value by identity without destroying its outer wrapper; an absent target must signal a defined error.
holds.falsifier: Flattening/destroying all outer wrappers, or silently replacing a different nested node, is not equivalent.

holds.source_section: The LOOPS Manual §5.3, printed page 26 (PDF page 30)
holds.observable_law: On first PUT to instance variable with active-value class default, clone active-value wrapper for that instance (sharing referenced immutable contents but private localState); #Shared marker permits shared instance of wrapper when user asserts no wrapper-local mutation.
holds.positive_witness: Two instances with same class default: first PUT allocates distinct outer wrapper for instance A; unrelated B retains class default. For #Shared, both see identical wrapper object.
holds.falsifier: Default instance receives mutated localState of another independent instance, or #Shared unexpectedly creates a distinct wrapper.
holds.why_not_selected: Derivability of class-default copy-on-first-write from existing DEFCLASS/SLOT-VALUE and explicit copy/alias algebra not yet proved.

evidence_limit: A bounded executable Python reference model is a consistency witness of this reading of the manual, NOT an independent historical LOOPS implementation oracle. No runtime or T5 execution claim.

integration_replay.note: The historical 625→627 initial LOOPS experiment is preserved in baseline; this stacked replay appends the same two rows only after distinct DPB/ARRAY and CLOS tranches.
